data.gender_notes: Bimal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bimal is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bimāl’, which means 'blessed' or 'consecrated'. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the bearer. It is also associated with the divine qualities of wisdom, courage, and strength. The name Bimal carries the meaning “Blessed, Consecrated” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bimal usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, consecrated and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bimal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
